field_and_group: Z/7Z with generator G=1 and additive group law
target_law: all w except w=1; initial group trace (G,wG)
encoding_law: all 7! bijections to labels 0..6 for each target scalar

comparison: group hit on either prior point versus symbolic affine collision, for all 30,240 scalar-encoding pairs
claim_boundary: complete finite control for one adaptive group-oracle step
